title: Yrmog's/z8md's TimeFixer mod
description: changes time makes it 10000. Clears weather makes it clear.
body:
# 
# Yrmog's TimeFix 
is a simple client-side Fabric mod
that locks the visual time of day to 10000 (bright mid-morning) and forces the sky to always render as clear weather — no rain, no storms.
Perfect for players who want consistent lighting for building, screenshots, or just prefer a bright world without relying on commands.  
Features:
## 
Locks visual time to 10000 (bright daytime)
Forces clear sky — no rain or thunder visually
Toggle on/off with F6 (rebindable in Controls)
100% client-side — works on any server

**Requirements**:
-  Minecraft 1.21.11
-  Fabric Loader 0.15.10+
-  Fabric API
